caption: The drawing depicts a single puppet figure with a painted wooden head, sporting dark, short, and messy hair. The puppet has pronounced facial features including large, arched eyebrows, wide eyes, a bulbous nose, prominent cheeks, and an exaggerated smiling mouth with large lips and visible teeth. The skin of the face is rendered in shades of peach, pink, and red, with some darker shading for contour. The puppet is dressed in a Victorian-style costume: a long-sleeved purple coat with lighter purple cuffs and collar trimmed with white ruffles, a pink shirt or dress underneath that extends below the coat, and purple knee-length breeches with white ruffles at the hems. The puppet also wears stockings colored in a light gray or white, and brown shoes. The right arm is bent at the elbow with an open hand, while the left arm is missing the hand. There are vertical brown and red striped elements behind the legs, possibly part of the puppet's skirt or background. The composition is centered on the figure against a plain, beige background and the artist's signature, "Ruth G. Abramson," is written at the bottom.
title: The Doctor Marionette
